calibration.reason: Global temperature scaling was fitted on dev (T=1.0226) and REJECTED: it left test ECE slightly worse (0.0554 -> 0.0604) and cut confidently-wrong on mixed reviews only 30.1% -> 29.0%. The miscalibration is conditional, not global -- uniform reviews are already near-perfectly calibrated (conf 0.876 vs acc 0.875) while mixed reviews are wildly over-confident (conf 0.771 vs acc 0.541). The two slices need opposite corrections (T=2.10 vs T=0.885), which cancel. Conditioning on aspect count was also tested and does not work: the gap is flat across counts. See docs/model.md.
